question: My TV has lines on the screen. I bought it in March. Is it still covered, and can you sort out a repair?
reference_answer: Your VisionMax 55" 4K TV (order VC-10001) was delivered on 12 March 2026. Lines on the screen are a panel defect, and panel defects are covered for 24 months from delivery, until 12 March 2028, so it is covered. Check the HDMI cable and try another port first. A repair ticket for VC-10001 has been drafted; it is only a draft that a person will review, not a submitted request.

question: Can I still return the AeroBuds Pro from order VC-10002? I've opened them.
reference_answer: Yes. Order VC-10002 was delivered on 20 October 2026. Opened audio products can be returned within 15 days of delivery, so the last day is 4 November 2026. Include all ear tips, cables and accessories.

question: I opened the AeroBuds Pro from order VC-10003. Can I send them back?
reference_answer: No. Order VC-10003 was delivered on 1 October 2026, and opened audio products can be returned within 15 days of delivery, so the window closed on 16 October 2026. I can't approve an exception, but a support agent can review it.

question: I opened my NoteBook 14 (order VC-10004). Can I return it, and is there a fee?
reference_answer: Yes. Order VC-10004 was delivered on 25 October 2026. Opened laptops can be returned within 15 days of delivery, until 9 November 2026, and a 10% restocking fee applies.

question: My smartwatch order VC-10006 arrived late. Can I get some compensation?
reference_answer: Order VC-10006 was delivered on 20 October 2026, 5 days after its estimated delivery date of 15 October 2026. I can't promise compensation; late deliveries are reviewed individually by the support team, and I can draft a ticket for an agent to review.

question: How do I factory reset the XR-2200 router?
reference_answer: With the router switched on, press and hold the reset button for 10 seconds until the LED blinks amber, then release it. The router restarts, which takes about two minutes.

question: A customer says the TV from order VC-20002 has dead pixels. Is it under warranty?
reference_answer: Yes. Order VC-20002 is a VisionMax 55" 4K TV delivered on 15 June 2026. Panel defects such as dead pixels are covered for 24 months from delivery, until 15 June 2028.
